scope: Screenshot capture only, after the submission was frozen. Startup readiness was observed. Navigation, collisions, input reliability, shader coverage and performance were not validated; no grade or vote was submitted.
viewpoint: Original authored starting viewpoint; no walking or camera adjustment.
captureMethod: Actual scene canvas copied directly to JPEG in the existing sandboxed Lab viewer. Separate DOM overlays/model labels are absent from canvas pixels. No synthesized content, source edits, lighting adjustment or scene repair.
consoleObservations: Blocked autofocusing on a <button> element in a cross-origin subframe.
captureHarnessNote: The first capture harness injected a service-worker blocker that touched an API unavailable in opaque sandboxed frames. This was an automation-only exception, unrelated to entrant source. This capture reached readiness and rendered successfully; the frame was unloaded normally.
browserCleanup: Capture browser sessions ran sequentially and were closed. No owned browser/test processes remained after capture.
